properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 10 at 3:23PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 323 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking thunderstorms along a line
extending from near Texas Creek to Coaldale to near Villa Grove.
Movement was east southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 40 to 50 mph and brief heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Texas Creek, Cotopaxi, Coaldale, Villa Grove, and Hillside.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 10 at 3:09PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 309 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 4
miles east of Shamrock, or 24 miles south of Fort Morgan, moving
northeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Landspouts, wind gusts up to 50 mph, and half inch size
hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to outdoor objects is possible. Gusty winds
could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured
objects.

Locations impacted include...
Shamrock and Woodrow.
